goal: DevPanel modular tabs: Alt+I keeps pulling up DevPanel, but the panel has tabs/slots: (1) Component Search (current cid+search-token surface), (2) Settings/Routes (jump to any route via search, also lists keyboard shortcuts), (3) Telemetry (live tail of gad telemetry models + sitrep), (4) Substrate (gad system status table), (5) Sessions (active Kael session list with handoff hooks). Tabs registered via TabRegistry pattern — each tab is a (id, label, render, shortcut?) tuple. Other apps can plug in tabs at module-load. Reference: VS Code Activity Bar pattern but for a single dev panel. Composes with GLOBAL-D-296 three-surface reuse — DevPanel package shared across desktop + platform + tui.
